subject: Kickoff: pretraining for irregular time series
body: Team, kickoff for pretraining on irregular time series. From our release: self-supervised pretraining for irregularly-sampled clinical time series, building on STraTS-style encoders, with geometric masking augmentations (pre-generated mask banks, since per-iteration mask generation proved too slow) and evaluation on PhysioNet Challenge 2012 — with MIMIC-III, eICU and the H&M retail dataset behind access agreements. Data-platforms angle: a pretraining recipe plus benchmark suite that health-science and commerce teams can reuse instead of hand-rolling encoders per dataset. Milestones: PhysioNet repro by April 10; pretraining-vs-scratch comparison across at least three datasets by mid-May; packaging decision by end of May. This is a short window, so scope discipline matters. Ivo owns staffing. Access paperwork for MIMIC-III/eICU starts today; it's the long pole. — Dmitri
